summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly transactions under its ongoing share buyback programme. The programme was announced via inside information on 4 February 2026. As of 15 July 2026, the bank has repurchased shares for €3,899,027,041, representing 77.5% of the maximum investment amount. The buyback has retired approximately 17.4% of outstanding shares since 2021. The filing lists daily purchases on XMAD and CEUX at weighted average prices between €11.9540 and €12.1509. The programme is a capital return to shareholders via open-market repurchases. Watch for completion pace towards the full €5B envelope.
